demands.name: Provision
demands.description: Food, water and fuel for everyone inside the walls.

bands.text: The markets are well supplied.
Bread prices are climbing.
There are queues at the bakers' doors.
The poorer wards are going hungry.
Famine. People are leaving or dying.

demands.name: Security
demands.description: Defence, order and fire — everything that keeps the city standing.

bands.text: The city sleeps soundly.
The watch is stretched thin.
Robbery and arson go unanswered.
Whole streets are lawless after dark.
The city cannot defend itself.

demands.name: Fairness
demands.description: Legitimacy: who governs, who pays, and who is heard.

bands.text: The council is trusted.
There is muttering about the levies.
Petitions arrive faster than they are read.
Crowds gather outside the town hall.
The city no longer accepts its rulers.

demands.name: Health
demands.description: Sanitation, disease and the cost of building people close together.

bands.text: The air and water are clean enough.
The lower lanes smell of the river.
The lower ward is sick.
Physicians cannot keep up with the burials.
Epidemic. The city is a danger to itself.

demands.name: Appeal
demands.description: Why anyone would choose to stay, or to come at all.

bands.text: People are glad to live here.
The young talk about the bigger towns.
Houses stand empty on the outer streets.
Anyone with a trade is leaving.
The city is being abandoned.
